summary: GH Research PLC filed a routine Form 6-K announcing the presentation of data from its GH001-TRD-201 and GH001-BD-202 clinical trials at the 39th European College of Neuropsychopharmacology annual meeting, scheduled October 10-13, 2026, in Munich, Germany. Three posters will be presented during Poster Session 2 on October 11, 2026, by Prof. Wieslaw J. Cubala, Prof. Bernhard T. Baune, and Dr. Max de Leeuw. The company will also sponsor an industry satellite symposium on rapid-acting antidepressants on October 10, 2026. This is an ordinary clinical/IR disclosure with no special-situation transaction, no deal terms, and no risk-arb angle.
